preset.label: Tested V1.0 · thesis nominal tank
preset.sourceNote: Nominal analysis of the tested, modified V1.0 hardware. The 1 nF entry is an equivalent tank capacitance, not a documented individual capacitor population. Carrier = 1 MHz; nominal resonance ≈ 988.941 kHz.

thesisTank.title: Thesis Chapter 4: Resonant Network and Transformer Ratio
thesisTank.detail: 07_Resonant_Stage.tex: 9.4 µH external series inductance + approximately 16.5 µH primary-referred leakage, with 1 nF equivalent resonant capacitance; approximately 989 kHz. This is a nominal model of the tested V1.0 assembly.

thesisMagnetics.title: Thesis Chapter 6: Electrical Reference Values
thesisMagnetics.detail: 02_Inherited_Specifications.tex: standalone transformer A leakage 16.42 µH, Lm 150.78 µH, primary/secondary turns ratio 8.039; B leakage 16.50 µH, Lm 139.89 µH, turns ratio 8.000. Installed A/B identity and post-assembly inductance were not recorded. Lm is a separate branch.

thesisHardware.title: Thesis Appendix B: Identity of the Tested Assembly
thesisHardware.detail: The tested V1.0 assembly used two Würth 7443640470B 4.7 µH inductors in series. Later drawing values do not identify the fitted final hardware. Individual resonant-bank capacitor population values are not recorded by the 1 nF lumped model.

tiModel.title: TI: Series resonant frequency and separate magnetizing branch
tiModel.detail: Supports fr = 1/(2π√(Lr Cr)); a complete resonant converter also includes the magnetizing branch and load.

rlcModel.title: Analog Devices: Resonance in RLC circuits
rlcModel.detail: Ideal series-RLC response with an explicitly entered series resistance. The response is not the measured transfer function of this converter.

preferredValues.title: Vishay: Preferred E-series values
preferredValues.detail: E12/E24 nominal series. Candidate values do not imply available components, tolerances or ratings.

inputUnits: SI: H, F, Hz, ohm; fractional tolerances

assumptions.model: Ideal LC resonance / ideal series RLC; not a full converter model
assumptions.tolerance: Independent low/high L-total and C corners; no measured component distribution
assumptions.magnetizingBranch: Linear primary-referred Lm; open-secondary LC estimate excludes load, rectifier conduction, switching, pump and parasitics
assumptions.transformerIdentity: A/B references are comparisons; installed identity is not recorded

warnings: Ideal series LC estimate: converter gain, ZVS, power, efficiency, parasitics, and component ratings require a separate model and measurement.
